request.query: Multivariate Hasse derivative of order zero is the identity on polynomials

content.text:
{
  "items": [
    {
      "formal_name": "Polynomial.hasseDeriv_zero'",
      "informal_name": "Zeroth Hasse Derivative is Identity",
      "kind": "theorem",
      "type": "∀ {R : Type u_1} [inst : Semiring R] (f : Polynomial R), (Polynomial.hasseDeriv 0) f = f",
      "informal_description": "The Hasse derivative of order zero applied to any polynomial $ f $ is equal to $ f $ itself, i.e., $ D^{(0)}(f) = f $.",
      "path": "Mathlib.Algebra.Polynomial.HasseDeriv"
    },
    {
      "formal_name": "Polynomial.hasseDeriv_zero",
      "informal_name": "Zeroth Hasse Derivative is Identity Map",
      "kind": "theorem",
      "type": "∀ {R : Type u_1} [inst : Semiring R], Polynomial.hasseDeriv 0 = LinearMap.id",
      "informal_description": "For any semiring $ R $, the Hasse derivative of order 0 on the polynomial ring $ R[X] $ is the identity linear map, i.e., $ D^{(0)}(f) = f $ for all polynomials $ f \\in R[X] $.",
      "path": "Mathlib.Algebra.Polynomial.HasseDeriv"
    },
    {
      "formal_name": "LaurentSeries.hasseDeriv_zero",
      "informal_name": "Hasse Derivative of Order Zero Equals Identity Map",
      "kind": "theorem",
      "type": "∀ {R : Type u_1} [inst : Semiring R] {V : Type u_2} [inst_1 : AddCommGroup V] [inst_2 : Module R V],\n  LaurentSeries.hasseDeriv R 0 = LinearMap.id",
      "informal_description": "The Hasse derivative of order $ 0 $ on Laurent series with coefficients in an $ R $-module $ V $ is the identity linear map, meaning it acts as the identity transformation on all Laurent series, leaving each series unchanged when $ k = 0 $.",
      "path": "Mathlib.RingTheory.LaurentSeries"
    },
    {
      "formal_name": "Polynomial.hasseDeriv_one",
      "informal_name": "First Hasse Derivative Equals Usual Derivative",
      "kind": "theorem",
      "type": "∀ {R : Type u_1} [inst : Semiring R], Polynomial.hasseDeriv 1 = Polynomial.derivative",
      "informal_description": "For the polynomial ring over a semiring $ R $, the Hasse derivative of order 1 coincides with the standard derivative, i.e., $ D^{(1)}(f) = f' $ for all polynomials $ f \\in R[X] $.",
      "path": "Mathlib.Algebra.Polynomial.HasseDeriv"
    },
    {
      "formal_name": "Polynomial.hasseDeriv_one'",
      "informal_name": "Hasse Derivative of Order 1 Equals Standard Derivative",
      "kind": "theorem",
      "type": "∀ {R : Type u_1} [inst : Semiring R] (f : Polynomial R), (Polynomial.hasseDeriv 1) f = Polynomial.derivative f",
      "informal_description": "For any polynomial $ f $ over a semiring $ R $, the Hasse derivative of order 1 applied to $ f $ coincides with the standard derivative of $ f $. Specifically, $ D^{(1)}(f) = f' $, where $ D^{(1)} $ denotes the first Hasse derivative and $ f' $ denotes the usual derivative in the polynomial ring $ R[X] $.",
      "path": "Mathlib.Algebra.Polynomial.HasseDeriv"
    },
    {
      "formal_name": "Polynomial.hasseDeriv_apply_one",
      "informal_name": "Hasse Derivative of the Constant Polynomial 1 is Zero for Positive Orders",
      "kind": "theorem",
      "type": "∀ {R : Type u_1} [inst : Semiring R] (k : ℕ), 0 < k → (Polynomial.hasseDeriv k) 1 = 0",
      "informal_description": "For any positive integer $ k $, the Hasse derivative of order $ k $ applied to the constant polynomial $ 1 $ yields the zero polynomial, i.e., $ D^{(k)}(1) = 0 $.",
      "path": "Mathlib.Algebra.Polynomial.HasseDeriv"
    },
    {
      "formal_name": "Polynomial.hasseDeriv_C",
      "informal_name": "Hasse Derivative of Constant Polynomial is Zero for Positive Order",

      "type": "∀ {R : Type u_1} [inst : Semiring R] (k : ℕ) (r : R), 0 < k → (Polynomial.hasseDeriv k) (Polynomial.C r) = 0",
      "informal_description": "For any semiring $ R $, the Hasse derivative of order $ k $ applied to the constant polynomial $ C(r) $ is zero for any positive integer $ k $. That is, $ D^{(k)}(C(r)) = 0 $ whenever $ k > 0 $.",
      "path": "Mathlib.Algebra.Polynomial.HasseDeriv"

      "formal_name": "Polynomial.hasseDeriv_X",
      "informal_name": "Hasse Derivative of Indeterminate for Order Greater Than One is Zero",

      "type": "∀ {R : Type u_1} [inst : Semiring R] (k : ℕ), 1 < k → (Polynomial.hasseDeriv k) Polynomial.X = 0",
      "informal_description": "For any semiring $ R $ and integer $ k > 1 $, the Hasse derivative of order $ k $ of the indeterminate $ X $ in the polynomial ring $ R[X] $ is the zero polynomial, i.e., $ D^{(k)}(X) = 0 $.",
      "path": "Mathlib.Algebra.Polynomial.HasseDeriv"

items.type: ∀ {R : Type u_1} [inst : Semiring R] (f : Polynomial R), (Polynomial.hasseDeriv 0) f = f
items.informal_description: The Hasse derivative of order zero applied to any polynomial $ f $ is equal to $ f $ itself, i.e., $ D^{(0)}(f) = f $.

items.informal_name: Zeroth Hasse Derivative is Identity Map
items.type: ∀ {R : Type u_1} [inst : Semiring R], Polynomial.hasseDeriv 0 = LinearMap.id
items.informal_description: For any semiring $ R $, the Hasse derivative of order 0 on the polynomial ring $ R[X] $ is the identity linear map, i.e., $ D^{(0)}(f) = f $ for all polynomials $ f \in R[X] $.

items.informal_name: Hasse Derivative of Order Zero Equals Identity Map
items.type:
∀ {R : Type u_1} [inst : Semiring R] {V : Type u_2} [inst_1 : AddCommGroup V] [inst_2 : Module R V],
  LaurentSeries.hasseDeriv R 0 = LinearMap.id
items.informal_description: The Hasse derivative of order $ 0 $ on Laurent series with coefficients in an $ R $-module $ V $ is the identity linear map, meaning it acts as the identity transformation on all Laurent series, leaving each series unchanged when $ k = 0 $.

items.informal_name: First Hasse Derivative Equals Usual Derivative
items.type: ∀ {R : Type u_1} [inst : Semiring R], Polynomial.hasseDeriv 1 = Polynomial.derivative
items.informal_description: For the polynomial ring over a semiring $ R $, the Hasse derivative of order 1 coincides with the standard derivative, i.e., $ D^{(1)}(f) = f' $ for all polynomials $ f \in R[X] $.

items.informal_name: Hasse Derivative of Order 1 Equals Standard Derivative
items.type: ∀ {R : Type u_1} [inst : Semiring R] (f : Polynomial R), (Polynomial.hasseDeriv 1) f = Polynomial.derivative f
items.informal_description: For any polynomial $ f $ over a semiring $ R $, the Hasse derivative of order 1 applied to $ f $ coincides with the standard derivative of $ f $. Specifically, $ D^{(1)}(f) = f' $, where $ D^{(1)} $ denotes the first Hasse derivative and $ f' $ denotes the usual derivative in the polynomial ring $ R[X] $.
